extractor_failed_empty.detail: the extraction produced no units for unchanged text
extractor_failed_empty.recovery: nothing about the source changed: keep the last good units and rerun the extraction; never replace them with an empty result

extractor_failed_error.recovery: nothing about the source changed: keep the last good units and rerun the extraction; never replace them with an empty result

source_missing.detail: the source is missing or unreadable
source_missing.recovery: keep the last good units (marked stale); ask the learner to restore the text or retire the source

source_text_replaced.detail: none of the 6 cited passages is in the new text
source_text_replaced.recovery: the units stay with their old revision; review each one against the new text, or restore the passage
